about: First meeting. Spiral for 2.9 s: q = easeInOutSine(t/2.9); theta = PI - (PI/2 + 2PI)*q; r = 55 + 1150*(1-q)^2.4; centre (512,681). Agent at theta, you at theta+PI. They meet at (512,736) and (512,626), then the four half-arms draw (1.25 s, easeInOutCubic) while stroke width grows 26→84 / 22→64.
